sql: select 'A_live_orders_all' as what, coalesce(status,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' group by status union all select 'B_orders_since_rearm','-', count(*)::text from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' and created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00' union all select 'C_open_paper_pos', strategy, count(*)::text from paper_positions where strategy in ('Emmsell10','Emmsell10_pt4','mmsell10','Gmmsell1') and status='open' group by strategy union all select 'D_funnel', se.created_at::text, concat('E=',coalesce(se.raw_json->'per_book'->>'Emmsell10','0'),' m10=',coalesce(se.raw_json->'per_book'->>'mmsell10','0'),' G1=',coalesce(se.raw_json->'per_book'->>'Gmmsell1','0'),' opened=',se.raw_json->>'opened',' ccap=',se.raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap',' tier=',se.raw_json->>'skipped_live_tier',' paused=',se.raw_json->>'skipped_live_paused',' inband=',se.raw_json->>'in_band') from system_events se where se.component='mmsell_scan' and se.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:40:00+00'
